old: Pungent, sour and salty tastes aggravate Pitta; sweet, sour and salty aggravate Kapha; and pungent, bitter and astringent provoke Vāta (samīraṇa).
new: Pungent, sour and salty tastes aggravate Pitta; sweet, sour and salty aggravate Kapha; and pungent, bitter and astringent aggravate Vāta (samīraṇa).
why: reviewer (minor): The verse has one verb (kopayanti) governing all three clauses, and the Hindi uses कुपित करते हैं throughout; the English switches from 'aggravate' to 'provoke' for the last clause, which suggests a different action.
